create.name: Aaron Michael Pyne
create.bio:
Aaron Michael Pyne, who teaches as the Elven Wizard, is a meditation guide, energy worker and visionary artist living in the Pacific Northwest. His interest in spiritual life began at seventeen, and over more than twenty years he has studied with a range of teachers in energy work, intuition and shamanic practice. He is a Reiki Master and an ordained minister. Earlier he set up iTemple community spaces in Bend, Oregon, and San Diego, which hosted monthly meditations, healing circles and ecstatic dance, and he has spoken at TEDxSkyforest in California about what trees can teach us.

His teaching mixes meditation with myth, fantasy and play. Inner Realms Journey, the system he created, turns guided meditation into an audio adventure in which the listener becomes the hero, backed by a guidebook and journal and a version for schools. He works with people one to one, in person or over Zoom, and leads custom half-day to weekend retreats among the forests and beaches of the Olympic Peninsula. He also holds mead ceremonies and officiates nature-themed and fantasy weddings. His End of Life Legacy Quest uses guided journeys and creative tasks to help people picture what may lie beyond death and leave something for their families. On Insight Timer he shares guided journeys and a course on meeting fears about death.

courses.title: Beyond Death, Reincarnation, & Heaven - Unraveling The Fear
courses.description: A four-day Insight Timer course in which Aaron looks at ideas of death, rebirth and heaven from several traditions and guides journeys to ease worry about what follows this life.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Retreats with the Elven Wizard
courses.description: Half-day, full-day or weekend retreats on Washington's Olympic Peninsula, shaped around each person or group. They can combine guided meditation and spirit journeys, ceremony, teaching and time in rainforest, on beaches and by waterfalls. Lodging is not included but can be arranged.

courses.title: Inner Realms Journey book and pass
courses.description: The printed guidebook and avatar journal for Inner Realms Journey, sold together with a pass to the online meditation adventures. Longer passes and a bundle with a Zoom session are offered as well.

courses.title: End of Life Legacy Quest
courses.description: Private guidance for people nearing the end of life, using audio journeys and creative activities to shape a personal vision of what lies beyond and to leave a keepsake for loved ones. It can be taken over a single day or spread across weeks.

free_resources.title: Aaron Michael Pyne on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Fantasy-flavoured guided journeys and meditations from Aaron, free to listen to in the app or online.

free_resources.title: Inner Realms Journey for kids: free trial
free_resources.description: Teachers and parents can try the first three adventure meditations for children aged eight and up, with a choice of creative activities to go with each one, before signing up.
